draft.presenting_complaints: Fever with cough and breathlessness for 5 days
hospital_course: Admitted 20/09/2026 with fever, productive cough, SpO2 91% RA; CXR showed right lower zone consolidation; diagnosed CAP; started IV ceftriaxone 1 g BD and oral azithromycin 500 mg OD, O2 support.
Afebrile after 24 hrs (23/09/2026); SpO2 96% RA; continued IV antibiotics.
Clinical status improving; patient stable at discharge.
